name: Candy Pastel
tagline: Peach-cream gradient with glossy macaron-colored spheres, Playfair Display italics in cocoa brown and rose-pink accents (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: warm peach-cream ground with cocoa-brown text, rose-pink accent and five macaron pastels

typography.style: high-contrast italic serif headlines with widely tracked small-caps Inter labels

best_for: Soft, delicate brand stories: patisserie, beauty, gifts, weddings, seasonal collections. Glossy pastel spheres give each slide a sweet, tactile accent.
avoid_for: Serious financial, technical or compliance material where the pastel sweetness undermines credibility.
